settings.question: What are Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)?
settings.answer: FSAs are an employee benefit offered by some employers in the U.S. that allow an eligible employee to set aide pre-taxed dollars into a savings account. These funds can be used to pay for most out-of-pocket medical, vision, and dental care expenses for yourself and your eligible dependents. For most plans, FSA dollars must be used within the year.

settings.question: What are Health Savings Accounts (HSAs)?
settings.answer: HSAs are an employee benefit offered by some employers in the U.S. that allow an eligible employee to set aide pre-taxed dollars into a savings account. These funds can be used to pay for most out-of-pocket medical, vision, and dental care expenses for yourself and your eligible dependents. HSA do not expire at the end of the benefit period.

settings.question: How do I pay for my FSA/HSA products?
settings.answer: When purchasing an FSA/HSA-eligible product, simply check out using your FSA and HSA debit card as the form of payment. Save your receipt to share with your benefits provider if needed. Please note, your cart must include FSA/HSA-eligible products only at checkout.

settings.question: What products are FSA/HSA-eligible?
settings.answer: All sunscreen products and CLENZIderm M.D. products are FSA/HSA-eligible.
